answer: Each identity posts a 70-credit bond on an oasis plot and files a fresh dune survey per epoch; it decays 7 each idle epoch, lapsing after ten. A nebula beacon sets a random audit hour; auditors recheck 10%; stale surveys burn the bond. First survey 42, k-th 42+8(k-1): 1,000 fakes cost 4,038,000 vs a 40,000 pool. Rented surveys fail: each is key-bound to its plot; a double filing burns both. Honest holders file one survey and keep the bond.
